n. [苏格兰英语]钟声；铃声；(钟等的)一敲

jowett.definition: n. English classical scholar noted for his translations of Plato and Aristotle (1817-1893)

jowitt.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 乔伊特 Jowett的变体

jowl.definition: n. a fullness and looseness of the flesh of the lower cheek and jaw (characteristic of aging)
jowl.translation: n. 颚骨, 下鄂的垂肉, 下鄂

jowle.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 乔尔 Jekyll的变体

jowled.translation: a. 有垂肉的,双下巴的

jowler.definition: n. A dog with large jowls, as the beagle.

jowles.translation: (jowle 的复数)  [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 乔尔 Jekyll的变体

jowls.definition:
n. the jaw in vertebrates that is hinged to open the mouth
n. a fullness and looseness of the flesh of the lower cheek and jaw (characteristic of aging)
jowls.translation: n. 颌, 颚骨, 面颊( jowl的复数形式 )

jowly.definition: s having sagging folds of flesh beneath the chin or lower jaw
jowly.translation: a. 下颚宽厚的, 有双下巴的
